skills.name: wi-code
skills.description: Code analysis and PR review: blast radius, change impact, pull request review, owners correlation. Use for goals like 'review this PR', 'blast radius for <file>', 'who else uses <module>'. Subcommand-dispatch.

skills.name: wi-disk-audit
skills.description: Audit macOS dev-machine disk usage and recover from runaway claude-mem bloat. Systematic walk (df → per-dir → find rogue big files) plus a proven three-stage claude-mem recovery (kill concurrent prunes → clean JSONL → VACUUM + wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) + FTS rebuild). Use when disk is full, claude-mem.db is multi-GB, or the daily prune cron is misbehaving.

skills.name: wi-dream
skills.description: Nightly memory-consolidation 'dream' pass. Reads the last 24h of human-typed session messages, compares against the memory brain, and PROPOSES memory changes into a gated report. Read-only: applies nothing — approve in the WI web UI /dream or run wi-dream-apply to land items.

model.rationale: Bucket D (digest-class synthesis): narrative pattern-finding across a day of transcripts; quality matters, volume is low.

skills.name: wi-dream-apply
skills.description: Apply approved proposals from a /dream report into the memory brain. Human-gated: writes memory/*.md, upserts the MEMORY.md index, mirrors to the palace, and commits each change as its own git commit (revertable). Reject items so the next dream never re-proposes them.

model.rationale: Bucket A: deterministic script does the work; the LLM only renders the per-item result lines.

skills.name: wi-record-outcome
skills.description: Close a pending Cypher session with an outcome verdict. After running a skill that /wi suggested, run this with the session_id and the verdict (success | mixed | failed) so Cypher's Beta priors update. Without this, Cypher's session stays 'pending' and the prior never moves — the agent never learns from your real usage.

skills.name: wi-remind
skills.description: Smart reminder skill — create, list, or detect reminders from chat/email. Fires to Apple Reminders (phone/Mac) and/or the Atlas morning brief. Understands natural language: 'remind me to do X by Friday', 'what do I need to remember?', 'scan my messages for deadlines'.
skills.argument_hint: [natural language reminder request | list | detect | snooze <id>]

skills.name: wi-review-adr
skills.description: Multi-dimensional review of an ADR, PRD, or long-form design doc. Reads the target doc + its cross-referenced context files, produces a structured markdown review across N dimensions (default 8 — architectural soundness, AC coverage, testing discipline, doc-vs-code drift, threat model, cost model, rollout safety, meta-consistency). Read-only. Closes GAP-003 Tier 1 for review-shape /wi goals.

skills.name: wi-router
skills.description: Engage Cypher (WI's senior-engineer agent) with a free-text goal. Cypher runs as an ADR-037 tool-use loop: the model picks tools from the WI catalog (palace recall, code-graph, Jira/Teams/GitHub search, brain decide, etc.), executes them, and returns its answer. The /wi front door for the loop. Prints the model's final surface as the answer.
skills.argument_hint: <free text goal — e.g. 'figure out why JIRA-15702 is flaky on dev' or 'review PR #4167'>

skills.name: wi-update-context
skills.description: Flush a Claude Code session into Work Intelligence — code edits, ticket investigations, AND pure-discussion / decision-capture sessions. Auto-detects scope (WI-own-source vs customer-repo vs topic-only). APPENDS to Jira ticket investigation notes (never overwrites). Writes to all 4 memory surfaces: WI bridge (bug capture / Jira notes / code-graph reindex / brain learn / profile observe), claude-mem session observations, MemPalace drawers, AND the user's auto-memory dir at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/ (bugs_resolved.md / decision_*.md / feedback_*.md / project_*.md + MEMORY.md index pointer). Use when the user says 'update wi context', 'sync wi', 'save this to wi', 'save this discussion', 'remember this', 'update memory', or after any non-trivial Claude Code session.
